logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.

moments.description: The Elder Nobleman corners Rupert in the hallway, warning him that the servants are discovering his secrets.
moments.key_dialogue: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.

moments.description: The Elder Nobleman physically pins Rupert against the wall with his walking stick, demanding brutal action.
moments.key_dialogue: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

moments.description: Catherine and the Elder Nobleman plot to twist Juliana's healing abilities into a capital witchcraft charge.
The Elder Nobleman outlines the full conspiracy to fabricate evidence, buy the jury, and sentence Juliana to death.
moments.key_dialogue: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.

moments.description: Catherine relishes the cruel fate awaiting Juliana as the town prepares to watch her hang.
moments.key_dialogue: She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose.

moments.description: Juliana is shown shivering and chained in the dark, flooded subterranean cell, completely unaware of the plot to execute her.
